summary: Branch has 2 unmerged commits (2026-05-12) that rename model_performance.success_rate_percent → success_rate in DB setup scripts and add a schema-safe backfill migration. The live model_performance table already has the 'success_rate' column (confirmed via psql \d model_performance), meaning the rename was applied through a different path (genome migrations 002_autonomy_tasks.sql or a manual script run). Three related PRs (274, 289, 703) were all CLOSED without merging. The originating task (7d2969fe) is DB-marked 'done' with code_review.status='merged' but PR 240 belongs to a completely different branch and was never merged — a data integrity inconsistency in the orchestrator. The fix content is already live in the database; the branch adds no new value and is safe to delete.

recommendation: safe-delete — The fix is already live in the DB. The branch adds no new value.
